result: Bare setup and doctor now infer `local` only when the enabled `.claude/settings.local.json` is in a trusted git work tree and git does not track it. Build and verify both exit 0.

The check is in `installedScope` (`scope.ts`). `claudeFolder` now also returns `root` and `trusted`. A new `tracked` helper runs `git ls-files --cached -- <file>` through the Shell and fails closed: a nonzero exit or any listed output counts as tracked. A tracked file, an untrusted folder or a folder with no git work tree stays at `user`. The `~ scope:` line then reads: `<file> enables HolyAgent but git tracks it` or `... but the folder is not a trusted git work tree, so it is not taken for your own uncommitted file; using user; --scope local targets it`. The project-file notice still follows it.
